description: This file defines and exports a plugin object for the ACPX runtime, including its metadata and registration logic. It imports necessary modules for runtime service creation, API types, and configuration schema, then registers the runtime service during plugin registration.

methods.name: configSchema
methods.description: Returns the configuration schema for the plugin using createAcpxPluginConfigSchema.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Register method that registers the ACpx runtime service with the provided API.
